About This Job
Are you a highly motivated multi-disciplinary engineer looking to work on building projects that can change the world, projects that are always more complex and innovative than the last?
We are looking for an experienced Senior Engineer to join our MEP team. This is a hybrid role and you could be based in our London, Croydon, St.Albans, Manchester, Leeds, Exeter, Cardiff or Bristol office to work across a broad range of sectors and for a broad range of clients.  You will be joining a team of like-minded experts that have a passion for innovation and delivering cutting edge solutions.
About Us:
AECOM plays a critical role in the conceptualisation and creation of amazing spaces, delivering projects and buildings that define skylines and communities. AECOM Buildings & Places – Design  is made up of dedicated teams delivering projects in Commercial, Residential, Hospitality, Sports Venues, Work Places, Data Centres, Education, Government, Healthcare and Defence.
We are friendly, busy and motivated with an established track record of successfully delivering local and overseas projects. Some of our flagship work in recent years include:
• Healthcare: AECOM is a leading award-winning consultant for the NHS in the UK and internationally, delivering projects ranging from major acute hospitals to primary care and estate refurbishment schemes, while supporting the NHS Net Zero Carbon agenda.
• Decarbonisation: Multiple projects where we have undertaken the feasibility of the removal of boilers and installation of Air Source and Water source heat pumps to provide the heating and cooling for the building. Projects include commercial buildings like 80 – 100 Victoria Street London, British Library, multiple residential buildings in the Royal Borough of Greenwich and even Windsor Castle.
• Stratford Cross: A major mixed-use regeneration development in Stratford, East London, located within the former Olympic Park area. Our team are providing multi-discipline services including MEP, civil & structural, vertical transportation, energy & sustainability, acoustics, air quality, ecology, transport, waste management, and façade engineering.
• Data Centres: Working for multiple major hyperscale projects in the Nordics, Iberia and South America. These projects provide the opportunity to tackle the issue of data management and storage specific to each country. Designing and implementing a highly resilient electrical infrastructure entails the usage of an efficient system that is highly sustainable.
• Lansdowne House: High-end commercial office development occupying the South-East side of Berkley Square, Mayfair, City of Westminster, with an all- electric energy centre containing Ground Source Heat Pumps, Air Source Heat Pumps and High Efficiency Chillers.
• 10 Dock: Western Europe’s largest naval dockyard in Plymouth, a defence project of enormous scale and multiple components that must come together as a solution to meet a new capability.
About Our Team:
Our award-winning and close-knit Building Services team have a strong presence across sectors and we have and a strong Public Health engineering team throughout the UK. The team is seeking to expand their capabilities further by adding a Senior Public Health Engineer with experience in delivering sustainable projects across multiple sectors, has excellent team working and co-ordination skills and strives for technical excellence.
You will be an integral part of the diverse and dynamic national AECOM PH team which will support your technical career development. Challenges such as the net zero agenda and water neutrality provide great opportunities for your career to flourish with the role also including Fire Protection systems design which will be supported by our experienced specialist fire protection engineering team to provide the opportunity to develop new design skills. The position is predominantly office located role to ensure face-to-face contact time with the team.
The Senior Engineer will be responsible for leading much of the Public Health and Fire Protection systems design on projects and involve client liaison, mentoring and leading the discipline/systems to prepare scheme and detailed engineering designs. The successful candidate will have proven design experience, delivering to quality, time and budget. This role will suit someone with who is enthusiastic, self-motivated, and looking to advance their career.
The role will include taking point lead on multiple PH systems design/calculations on a project as well as assisting the lead PH engineer with experience in the following systems:
• Hot and cold water systems
• Above ground foul and rainwater system
• Fire Protection Systems
• Below Ground drainage systems
• Pumped drainage systems
• Water and oil leak detection systems
• Rainwater harvesting and Greywater recycling systems
• Water conservation solutions
• BREEAM, LEED and Ska Rating design integration
Duties of the role will include, but not be limited to;
• Maintaining Client relationships
• Mentoring and developing staff
• Project Managing small sized multi-disciplinary projects
• Obtain the necessary information both internally and externally from Architects, Quantity Surveyors and Design Consultants to provide a fully coordinated design
• Ensure the Design Team is kept fully informed of all technical and other information necessary for the duration of the project
• Be familiar with the BIM design process and be capable of input and support for projects designed in Revit
• Ensure compliance with all Statutory and Regulatory obligations, make submissions to the Statutory Authorities and obtain approvals as necessary
• Produce all design information and ensure that all calculations are prepared and signed off in accordance with the requirements of the QA procedures, relevant Standards and Codes of Practice
• Represent AECOM at Client, Design Team and Progress meetings throughout the design and construction phases of projects
• Support AECOM PM with input to pre-qualification and selection of contractors, also respond to tender queries, comment and review tender returns
• Ensure the project work complies with the Project Management Plan and Programme
• Understand and implement AECOM’s Safety Health and Environment Policy
Minimum Requirements:
• Previous public health engineering work experience within design consultancy or other relevant business
• A comprehensive working knowledge of statutory regulations to ensure design compliance, make submissions to the statutory authorities and obtaining approvals as necessary
• Be able to work independently and have good time/task management skills
• Experience in mixed used, residential, commercial and healthcare buildings/sectors
• Fully competent in the use of AutoCad to produce 2D drawings
• Fully competence in using 3D Revit software and Navisworks reviewing software
• Ability to speak fluently and communicate effectively in written reports and oral presentations

AECOM’s Ports and Maritime team is seeking a Graduate Ports Engineer with a civil and structural academic background to support in a technical role across multiple UK and international projects.

Broaden and deepen the Bank’s distribution and investor network across banks, non-bank financial institutions, development finance institutions, credit insurers, private credit and private equity credit funds, fixed-income and emerging-market debt funds, asset managers, family offices, insurance investors and other institutional capital providers.
•
Develop and maintain a detailed investor appetite and market-intelligence framework, ensuring likely funding sources are identified early and that investor requirements inform transaction development, pricing, structuring and marketing.
•
Execute distribution strategies for trade-finance assets and facilities on a funded and unfunded basis, including the preparation and coordination of transaction summaries, teasers, information memoranda, investor presentations, data rooms and other marketing materials.
•
Act as a subject-matter expert for the placement of structured finance and commodity finance risk, assessing distributability and marketability across cash flows, collateral, borrowing-base mechanics, security arrangements, credit enhancement, repayment sources and other relevant risk mitigants.
•
Work with Origination, Structuring and Coverage to convert opportunities into fundable, executable and investor-ready transactions, including commodity finance, structured credit, portfolio solutions, risk-sharing structures and other transactions designed to mobilise institutional capital.
•
Identify and structure appropriate combinations of bank funding, institutional capital, development finance and credit insurance to support transactions requiring multiple sources of risk capacity.
•
Manage syndication opportunities end to end, including opportunity assessment, syndication strategy, client pitches, approval materials, syndicate formation, investor engagement, documentation, execution, financial close and any post-closing sell-down.
•
Coordinate lender and investor communications throughout syndication and distribution processes, ensuring consistent, accurate and timely information is provided and that confidentiality, due diligence, pricing, allocation and closing processes are managed effectively.
•
Collaborate with Coverage, Product, Credit, Risk, Legal, Compliance, Operations, Finance and other stakeholders to identify opportunities early, support cross-selling, capture client flows and ensure transactions meet the Bank’s credit, legal, regulatory, operational and commercial objectives.
•
Monitor market developments across syndicated lending, private credit, structured finance, commodity finance, credit insurance and emerging-market fixed income, identifying trends that may affect investor appetite, pricing or transaction structures.
•
Represent the Bank with investors, clients and market participants at meetings, conferences and external forums, including acting as a public speaker, panellist or Bank representative when required and where significant travel may be necessary.

Qualifications
Qualification
•
Relevant degree, professional qualification or equivalent experience in banking, finance, capital markets, credit, structured finance, trade finance or a related discipline.
•
Fluency in written and spoken English is essential; fluency in one or more additional languages is desirable.

Minimum five years’ relevant experience in syndications, distribution, structured finance, commodity finance, private credit placement, emerging-market credit or a closely related role, preferably with direct emerging-markets exposure.
•
Demonstrable track record of distributing or placing trade finance, structured finance and commodity finance risk across bank, insurance, development finance and institutional investor channels.
•
Established access to buy-side investors and alternative capital providers, including private credit funds, asset managers, specialist trade and commodity funds, family offices and insurance investors.
•
Strong technical knowledge of trade-finance products, primary loan syndication, funded and unfunded participations, assignments, secondary loan sales, credit insurance and banking operations.
•
Strong understanding of credit risk, transaction structuring, risk allocation, pricing, investor requirements and the full execution cycle from market sounding through to documentation, allocation and closing.
•

Entrepreneurial, commercially focused and proactive, with strong relationship-building, communication, presentation and stakeholder-management skills.

About This Job
This is a 14 month Fixed Term Contract role.
Join the team redefining how the world experiences design.
Kamusta, hey, g'day, mabuhay, kia ora, 你好, hallo, vítejte!
Thanks for stopping by. We know job hunting can be a little time consuming and you're probably keen to find out what's on offer, so we'll get straight to the point.
Where and how you can work
This role is based in London with 2-3 days in the office. The buzzing Canva London campus features several buildings around beautiful leafy Hoxton Square in Shoreditch. While our global headquarters is in Sydney, Australia, London is our HQ for Europe, with all kinds of teams based here, plus event spaces to gather our team and communities. You'll experience a warm welcome from our Vibe team at front of house, amazing home cooked food from our Head Chef, and a variety of workspaces to hang out with your team mates or get solo work done. That said, we trust our Canvanauts to choose the balance that empowers them and their team to achieve their goals and so you have choice in where and how you work.
About the role
As our Talent Acquisition Lead for EMEA, you’ll lead the regional Talent Acquisition team of 5 and be a strategic partner to leaders shaping Canva’s growth across a vastly expanding region as we enter new markets.
This is a rare opportunity to have visible, hands-on impact during a defining period for Canva in EMEA. You’ll lead a talented team while helping shape how we enter new countries, build local capability and scale sustainably across one of Canva’s fastest-growing regions. The work will be varied, commercially meaningful and highly connected to the region’s growth agenda.
EMEA is entering an exciting phase of expansion. As we grow in existing markets and establish Canva in new ones, you’ll help turn ambitious growth plans into clear, achievable talent strategies. You’ll partner closely with regional leaders and Country Managers to understand what capabilities they need, where we should hire, and the best ways to build those teams.
This is a role for someone who is comfortable creating clarity in complexity. You’ll balance competing priorities across markets and specialties, connect regional needs with global teams, and help leaders make thoughtful decisions about where to focus our hiring efforts.
What you’d be doing in this role
As Canva scales change continues to be part of our DNA. But we like to think that's all part of the fun. So this will give you the flavour of the type of things you'll be working on when you start, but this will likely evolve.
At the moment, this role is focused on:
•
Being a strategic thought partner to EMEA regional leadership and Country Managers, bringing a strong talent perspective to workforce priorities, challenging assumptions and helping turn ambitious growth and market-entry plans into practical hiring strategies.
•
Helping shape EMEA’s talent acquisition operating model as the region scales, establishing practical, repeatable approaches for new-market hiring while preserving the local nuance each country needs.
•
Leading and developing a high-performing regional TA team, creating clarity on priorities, aligning capacity to the work that matters most and helping the team navigate a fast-moving hiring landscape.
•
Building talent strategies for new and evolving markets, partnering across People, Total Rewards, Legal, Contingent Workforce and other teams to understand local talent, compensation and benefits, worker types and the practicalities of hiring in each country.
•
Creating clarity when priorities compete, connecting regional leaders, Country Managers and global specialty stakeholders when needs aren't naturally aligned and helping the group reach clear, pragmatic decisions.
•
Shaping the right workforce approach, considering permanent, fixed-term and contingent talent based on the market, business need and available hiring pathways.
•
Leading hiring across a broad portfolio of specialties, with priorities spanning areas such as Growth, Marketing, SEO, Content and Customer Service, alongside leadership and other emerging roles.
•
Using market insight to influence decisions, helping leaders understand talent availability, capacity, trade-offs and investment required to deliver against changing hiring priorities.
You're probably a match if
•
You’ve led Talent Acquisition across multiple EMEA markets, ideally supporting international or new-market expansion in high growth environments.
•
You’re a strong people leader who builds high-performing teams through clear direction, trust and coaching.
•
You’re an experienced strategic partner who can influence senior leaders, challenge assumptions and navigate competing priorities.
•
You bring strong commercial and market judgement, balancing business ambition with talent availability, capacity and hiring realities.
•
You’re comfortable with ambiguity and change, creating clarity and momentum when priorities shift.
•
You can move easily between strategy and execution, staying close enough to the work to unblock challenges and drive outcomes.
•
You’re excited by the opportunity to build, not just maintain, bringing structure to new-market expansion while keeping candidate experience and hiring quality high.
What's in it for you?
Achieving our crazy big goals motivates us to work hard - and we do - but you'll experience lots of moments of magic, connectivity and fun woven throughout life at Canva, too. We also offer a range of benefits to set you up for every success in and outside of work.
Check out lifeatcanva.com for more info.
Other stuff to know
We make hiring decisions based on your experience, skills and passion, as well as how you can enhance Canva and our culture. When you apply, please tell us the pronouns you use and any reasonable adjustments you may need during the interview process.
We celebrate all types of skills and backgrounds at Canva so even if you don’t feel like your skills quite match what’s listed above - we still want to hear from you!
Please note that interviews are conducted virtually.

About This Job
We’re looking for a Risk Lead to join the Global Risk team at Wise and focus on enabling our Wise Assets product to meet its strategic objectives. This is a second line role and will report into the Head of Risk Product Governance.
Wise Assets is an investment product that allows eligible customers to earn a return on their money by investing it in the market rather than holding it as cash. It is a self-directed feature within the Wise multi-currency account where funds are placed into money market funds or stocks managed by third-party fund managers.
YOUR MISSION
You will partner with the Head of Risk Product Governance and the wider Risk organisation to strengthen and continuously evolve the risk management programme supporting Wise Assets.
You will help ensure that risk frameworks are effectively embedded into the product lifecycle, operational processes, and strategic decision-making, while enabling Wise Assets to scale responsibly across multiple jurisdictions.
You will provide independent challenge, oversight and guidance to ensure risks are identified early, appropriately assessed, transparently reported, and effectively managed through enhancements to the control environment.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
•
Implement and embed Wise’s Enterprise Risk Management Framework (ERMF), associated policies, standards and methodologies across the Wise Assets product ecosystem, ensuring alignment with product developments and appropriate prioritisation of regulatory requirements. This will include establishing and maintaining risk appetite for Assets.
•
Partner with first line teams and co-ordinate with regional risk colleagues to ensure risk management practices are consistently applied and operating effectively across product, operational and governance processes.
•
Provide independent second line oversight and challenge on risk assessments, control design, control effectiveness and residual risk decisions relating to Wise Assets activities and initiatives.
•
Support product growth and innovation by reviewing new products, features, market expansions and strategic initiatives, providing pragmatic risk advice and recommending proportionate mitigation strategies.
•
Apply ERMF methodologies, including RCSAs, to drive risk and control mapping and assessment activities, ensuring key risks, controls, dependencies and monitoring mechanisms are clearly identified and maintained.
•
Oversee control assurance activities and monitor the effectiveness of key controls, identifying areas of weakness, emerging risks, or control gaps requiring remediation.
•
Own and coordinate issue management activities for Wise Assets, including tracking remediation plans, challenging delivery timelines, escalating delays or material concerns, and ensuring actions are completed in line with enterprise standards and policy requirements.
•
Monitor key risk indicators, operational incidents, control failures and emerging trends to proactively identify deteriorating risk exposures or areas requiring management intervention.
•
Support the development and delivery of risk training and awareness initiatives across Wise Assets, helping strengthen risk culture and risk ownership within the business.
•
Produce high-quality risk reporting and insights for governance committees and senior stakeholders, ensuring reporting is data-driven, clear, actionable and focused on material risk themes.
•
Report on risks operating outside approved appetite thresholds, including escalation of significant exposures, thematic concerns, or persistent control weaknesses.
•
Provide qualitative and quantitative analysis of incidents, issues and remediation activities impacting Wise Assets, including trend analysis and escalation where required.
•
Consolidate risk insights across regions to support enterprise-wide reporting and contribute to effective decision-making at Group governance forums.
•
Build strong relationships with Product, Compliance, Operations, Engineering, Legal, Audit and Regional Risk teams to ensure risk management supports commercial growth while maintaining robust governance standards.

Qualifications
•
Significant experience within financial services, fintech, banking, wealth management, or investment environments, with a strong track record in first or second line risk management roles.
•
Experience working within or supporting investment products, asset management, brokerage, or regulated investment firms is strongly preferred.
•
Demonstrated experience implementing or operating enterprise risk management frameworks within regulated financial services organisations.
•
Strong understanding of non-financial risk management concepts and methodologies, including operational risk, regulatory risk, conduct risk, financial crime risk and control governance.
•
Proven ability to provide effective independent challenge and escalation while maintaining strong and constructive stakeholder relationships.
•
Experience assessing complex products, operational processes, and control environments in fast-paced or scaling organisations.
•
Strong analytical, data management and reporting skills, including the ability to translate complex risk information into clear, concise and impactful insights for senior management, governance committees and regulators.
•
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders across different levels of seniority and functions.
•
A pragmatic, commercially aware and solutions-oriented mindset, with the ability to balance effective risk management against business growth and customer outcomes.
•
Strong organisational skills and ability to manage multiple priorities, deliver to tight timelines and operate effectively in a fast-changing environment.
•
An inquisitive mindset and strong interpersonal skills, with a desire to deeply understand how products operate and how risks evolve as the business scales.
•
Experience working in global and cross-functional environments, particularly within technology-driven or high-growth organisations, would be highly advantageous.

Additional Information
Hybrid working - 3 days onsite and 2 from home
Working hours - 9am to 6pm

takeaway.wd3.myworkdayjobs.com/jet-ecs-r.description_excerpt:
Ready for a challenge?
Then Just Eat Takeaway.com might be the place for you. We’re a leading global online delivery platform, and our vision is to empower everyday convenience.
Whether it’s a Friday-night feast, a post-gym poke bowl, or grabbing some groceries, our tech platform connects tens of millions of customers with hundreds of thousands of restaurant, grocery and convenience partners across the globe.
About this role
Our logistics network spans 16 markets, hundreds of thousands of couriers and more than 350 million orders a year. Behind every order are real-time decisions: who delivers it, when, and at what price. Models running in production make them.
We are looking for a Director of Data Science & Machine Learning to lead the function behind those decisions and take the optimisation of our network to the next level. This is a leader-of-leaders role: a global team of 90+ data scientists, operations research scientists, ML engineers and MLOps engineers, led through managers and principal data scientists. You will set the DS/OR/ML agenda, not just run it.
The challenge is dual: keeping the real-time decision systems reliable at marketplace scale, while pushing the frontier on optimisation, supply/demand shaping and applied AI.
Location: Hybrid, 3 days a week from our London or Amsterdam office and 2 days working from home
These are some of the key components to the position:
• Deliver measurable improvement in delivery time, courier utilisation, cost per order, and the efficiency of courier pay.
• Own the strategy and roadmap for real-time decision systems: demand forecasting and supply balancing, order-to-courier assignment, and dynamic pay and fee pricing. All running as low latency production services at marketplace scale.
• Understand and shape courier behaviour: lead incentive and pay design grounded in economics and causal modelling, anticipating how couriers respond to the levers we pull
• Set the Operations Research agenda: combinatorial optimisation, exact and heuristic solvers, and simulation for capacity planning and policy testing
• Set the bar for validation before launch: backtesting and simulation frameworks that gate models going into production
• Own the quality of the ML platform and MLOps standards: feature and model pipelines, CI/CD, online and batch serving, monitoring and drift detection
• Drive experimentation and causal inference in a marketplace, including switchback and geo-based designs where network effects break standard A/B tests, and connect short-term experiment results to long-term outcomes such as courier retention and network health
• Build applied AI that delivers value in production, including LLM-based and agentic products for couriers and operations
• Build the organisation: hire, develop managers and principals, and build university partnerships
• Partner with Logistics Product, Logistics Engineering, Commercial and central Technology on production delivery of dispatch, estimations, pay, and supply/demand shaping actions, aligning on priorities and outcomes
What will you bring to the team?
• Leadership experience in Data Science, ML or Operations Research, including significant experience leading large organisations through managers across time zones, and developing those managers
• Deep credibility in real-time ML and marketplace or network optimisation (logistics, ride-hailing, delivery or similar)
• Experience taking models from research into low-latency production at scale
• Strong grounding in experimentation and causal inference under network effects, and in the economics of multi-sided marketplaces where participants respond strategically
• Excellent stakeholder management and communication, able to influence at the Product and Engineering leadership table and translate technical choices into business outcomes
• A pragmatic approach to AI: you ship value, not demos
• Advanced degree in a quantitative field (or equivalent experience)
At JET, this is how we play
Our teams forge connections internally and work with some of the best-known brands on the planet, giving us truly international impact in a dynamic environment.
Being the best at what we do isn’t just about delivering on our strategy. It's a competition for something incredibly valuable – our customers' choice. Every time a customer decides where to order, they're picking a side.
At the heart of the JET Customer League are our values and behaviours. They guide every interaction, every decision, every innovation. These are the actions we need to perform consistently and brilliantly, to surpass the competition and earn our customers’ loyalty, again and again.
Fun, fast-paced and supportive, the JET culture is about movement, growth, helping one another to succeed and celebrating wins. By truly living our values and embodying our behaviours, we’re building a customer-first culture which enables us to stay one step ahead of the competition.
Inclusion, Diversity & Belonging
No matter who you are, what you look like, who you love, or where you are from, you can find your place at Just Eat Takeaway.com. We’re committed to creating an inclusive culture, encouraging diversity of people and thinking, in which all employees feel they truly belong and can bring their most colourful selves to work every day.
What else are we delivering?
Want to know more about our JETers, culture or company? Have a look at our career site where you can find people's stories, blogs, podcasts and more JET journeys.

Our London office is based just a stone’s throw from the magnificent St. Paul’s Cathedral on bustling King Edward Street. Here you’ll find modern workspaces and a state-of-the-art auditorium space. You will play a key part in enabling efficient client onboarding, supporting business growth and ensuring compliance with regulatory and internal standards, while gaining broad exposure across products and stakeholders.
You will act as a relationship manager for a portfolio of priority Markets clients, serving as the primary point of contact for documentation negotiations across Markets agreement suite. You will develop a close partnership with Sales, Onboarding and other internal stakeholders, giving you a highly visible position within the business and a clear line of sight into how commercial and credit decisions are executed through documentation. The Sales Director leads the sales strategy, execution, and performance across the assigned Material Science sub-industry/application in EMEA. This role translates product basket and portfolio strategies into account-specific sales plans, pricing execution, and pipeline growth. The Sales Director partners closely with IMM, Product Management, Supply Chain, Operations, and Technical teams to drive revenue, GP margin, and customer value through solution-selling and market activation. The position is central to developing market insights, identifying growth opportunities, and supporting Material Science’s long-term strategic direction.

Sales Strategy, Account Leadership, and Pipeline Management (50%)
• Translate product baskets and portfolio guidance into regional sales plans with clear revenue, GP margin, and share-of-wallet targets.
• Define priority customer segments and target accounts; lead account planning, territory design, and coverage models.
• Build and manage a healthy opportunity pipeline; drive opportunity qualification, stage progression, and conversion rates.
• Lead sales teams to push revenue and profit growth across targeted product baskets and identify customer demands beyond existing product portfolio
• Collaborate with operations and supply chain teams to drive efficiency and productivity.

• Coordinate with Account Managers and Sales Managers to execute strategic campaigns, new product introductions, and customer value propositions.

Industry/Application Know-How and Market Activation (30%)
• Develop deep market and application expertise to co-create strategies with IMM aligned to the Material Science Industry Market Management framework.
• Identify trends and technologies with commercial potential, define priority segments and growth areas, and convert insights into actionable sales plays and strategic narratives

• Activate campaigns and technical storytelling to support the sales organization and accelerate adoption of new solutions.
• Monitor portfolio balance and alignment with internal stakeholders to avoid conflicts and ensure compliance with regulatory and quality requirements.
Pricing Execution and Margin Management (20%)
• Implement pricing guidance derived from IMM’s market intelligence and supplier input
• Maintain accurate pricing information in relevant systems; monitor price/mix development and drive margin optimization initiatives.

Role Summary
The RFP Content Manager plays a key role in shaping and managing the global RFP content capability at T. Rowe Price. Working closely with content team colleagues, the Global RFP team, subject matter experts and stakeholders across the firm, this role ensures our RFP content library stays accurate, relevant and easy to use while supporting ongoing improvements to how content is created, governed and delivered.
This role combines content management, stakeholder engagement and process improvement with the opportunity to help shape the use of technology and AI across the RFP lifecycle. The RFP Content Manager will maintain a defined portfolio of content, support governance and review cycles, and contribute ideas to improve the experience for RFP teams and content users globally.

Content Maintenance & Stakeholder Collaboration
• Maintain assigned RFP content with a global perspective and a consultative approach, ensuring content is clear, current, and easy to use, and communicating changes to content users as needed.
• Partner with RFP Editors, subject matter experts, investment teams, and other content owners to support the ongoing enhancement, refinement, and maintenance of content for specific topics and strategies – including timely resolution of content gaps or questions and ad hoc critical communications edits.
Governance & Process
• Support content governance and review cycles to ensure records remain current, accurate, appropriately owned, and reviewed within established timelines — leading large-scale quarterly updates and identifying outdated, duplicative, or underutilized content for remediation.
• Help maintain procedures and user guides covering content management processes, including intake and approval of new or updated content, incorporation of critical communications, and review cycle procedures.
• Collaborate with the Lead Content Manager and Lead Content Writer on process reviews and content initiatives, helping identify opportunities to improve content quality, efficiency, and the broader content management process.
Training & Continuous Improvement
• Support RFP content users through training on functionality, usage, and best practices, delivered on both a recurring and ad hoc basis.
• Identify and apply opportunities to use AI and other available technology in day-to-day content management work to improve efficiency, quality, and consistency.
• Partner with content team members, RFP stakeholders, and technology teams to support broader content-management improvements, including initiatives involving AI, automation, taxonomy, metadata, tagging, templates, and workflow enhancements.

• Bachelor's degree or the equivalent combination of education and relevant experience AND
• 3+ years of relevant work experience in a similar role within Asset Management
Preferred:
• Experience working with content management and workflow systems and repositories, especially Responsive.
• Demonstrates an interest in the application of technology in business processes, including AI and other software to enhance workflow.
• Prior experience in RFP writing roles
• Self-motivated and able to work independently in a deadline-driven environment
• A willingness to learn new things and a positive attitude
• Strong communication and problem-solving skills
• Detail-oriented

At Hexcel, our maintenance engineers do far more than keep equipment running. They play a pivotal role in enabling the innovation that powers some of the world's most advanced aerospace and industrial technologies. This is an opportunity to take ownership of a diverse pilot plant environment, working at the intersection of engineering excellence and research and development.
As a Maintenance Engineer at our Leicester site, you will enjoy:
• Autonomy and Ownership: Supporting the site's maintenance strategy, driving reliability, performance, and continuous improvement initiatives.
• A Unique Engineering Environment: Working with cutting-edge pilot plant equipment that underpins the development of next-generation composite materials and manufacturing technologies.
• Visible Impact: Collaborating with our R&D team where your maintenance expertise will impact site productivity and innovation.
With our strong investment in research and development and our culture of continuous improvement, Hexcel is the industry leader in the manufacturing of advanced lightweight composite materials, including carbon fibre, woven reinforcements, resins, prepregs, honeycombs, engineered core and composite structures. We invite you to join the Hexcel team at our Leicester site and become part of the "strength within."
Key Responsibilities
• Own and manage the Planned Preventative Maintenance (PPM) programme to maximise equipment reliability, availability, and operational performance.
• Develop, implement, and continuously improve maintenance schedules and maintenance strategies across the pilot plant.
• Provide hands-on technical support for equipment breakdowns, diagnosing faults and coordinating effective repairs to minimise downtime.
• Ensure maintenance activities comply with company procedures, engineering best practice, safety requirements, and relevant legislation.
• Collaborate with the R&D Technical Manager and operational teams to schedule maintenance activities with minimal disruption.
• Lead root cause investigations and implement corrective actions to improve equipment reliability and maintenance effectiveness.
• Manage external contractors and service providers, ensuring safe working practices and delivery to agreed standards.
• Control spare parts and maintenance inventory, mitigating risk and ensuring critical parts availability.
• Maintain accurate maintenance records, reports, and documentation to support compliance and continuous improvement.
• Champion a strong safety culture, ensuring safe isolation procedures, contractor compliance, and adherence to site safety standards.
What We're Looking For
• Proven experience in a Maintenance Engineer, Reliability Engineer, or similar engineering role within manufacturing, process, industrial, R&D, or engineering environments.
• Mechanical, electrical, or multi-skilled engineering expertise with strong technical fault-finding and diagnostic capability.
• Experience managing Planned Preventative Maintenance (PPM) systems and maintenance planning activities.
• Strong understanding of health and safety regulations and engineering best practices within an industrial environment.
• Experience coordinating contractors, suppliers, and external service providers.
• Demonstrated ability to investigate equipment issues, identify root causes, and implement sustainable solutions.
• Strong organisational and planning skills with the ability to manage competing priorities effectively.
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to build effective cross-functional relationships.
• Proactive, hands-on approach with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.
• HNC/HND (or equivalent) in Mechanical, Electrical, or a related Engineering discipline. Knowledge of PUWER, LOLER, and HSE regulations is desirable, alongside an engineering apprenticeship background.

Field Support

• Provide factory-based technical support to field teams and customers.
• Establish and maintain strong customer relationships through effective technical support.
Qualifications and Experience
The successful candidate will have:
• Master's degree, or Bachelor's degree in a relevant discipline, together with relevant industrial experience. Candidates with equivalent qualifications and hands-on semiconductor process engineering experience are also encouraged to apply
• Experience of plasma etch processing within a semiconductor environment.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Experience with semiconductor metrology techniques.
• SEM experience would be advantageous, although training can be provided.
• Knowledge and practical experience of endpoint detection techniques.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills.

• Excellent organisational and time-management skills.

About Analog Devices
Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at www.analog.com and on LinkedIn and X.
Solutions and Tool Specialist – Functional Safety
About the Role
Safety-critical semiconductor products are growing across every market ADI serves. The Functional Safety Office (FSO) is a global team responsible for independent safety confirmation at the highest integrity levels per ISO 26262, and the tooling and infrastructure that supports that work needs to scale with the portfolio.
This role puts you at the center of that challenge. You will build reusable analysis infrastructure — starting with Medini Analyze component libraries — support the development of training content, and work across multiple product families and design types rather than being embedded in a single program. You will gain broad cross-portfolio exposure to how safety-critical semiconductor products are developed.
This role offers a structured path into functional safety — with mentoring from experienced Safety Specialists, progressive project exposure, and the opportunity to build the tooling infrastructure that shapes how safety engineering scales across ADI. You are not expected to arrive as a functional safety expert. You are expected to arrive as an engineer with a solid foundation in semiconductor product development or quality engineering who wants to build tools, tool interfaces, reusable assets and workflows that improve engineering execution.
Why This Team
The FSO operates as ADI's independent safety authority, working across business units and product families rather than within a single design group. The team is global and high-impact — the tooling and methods you help build here will be used across every safety-critical product ADI ships. You will gain exposure to a breadth of product architectures and safety challenges that few individual contributor roles in the industry offer.
Job Responsibilities:
Support, develop and maintain reusable component libraries in Medini Analyze for safety analysis (FMEDA, FTA, dependent failure analysis) across ADI product families, working alongside the FSO's Safety Specialists to ensure technical accuracy and standards compliance.
Work with the FSO team and BU teams to standardize analysis templates and modeling patterns, and translate product-family-specific safety architectures into reusable, parameterized components that improve consistency and reduce setup time for new assessments.
Support the development of role-based training content for common safety activities including FMEDA execution, safety case construction, and safety requirements writing.
Engage with tool vendors such as Synopsys-Ansys (Medini Analyze) on capability evaluation, feature requests, and user community activities.
Develop functional safety domain expertise through structured mentoring and progressive project exposure, contributing to confirmation reviews and safety assessments as competence develops.
Who You Will Work With:
Day-to-day: You will work alongside the FSO's Safety Specialists around the world, who provide technical direction and mentoring on safety analysis and Medini.
Across the FSO: You will collaborate with Functional Safety Managers and Safety Specialists globally to understand where enablement assets have the highest impact.
Engineering teams: You will work with Design Engineers across business units who are the consumers of the tools, templates, and training content you help build.
Tool vendors: You will participate in vendor engagements with Synopsys-Ansys (Medini Analyze) and others on tool capabilities and integration.
Required Qualifications:
• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
• 5+ years of experience in semiconductor design engineering, quality engineering, systems engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
• Solid understanding of semiconductor product development processes and lifecycle.
• Experience with structured analytical methods used in product development such as FMEA, design verification, characterization, simulation, or reliability analysis.
• Experience building reusable technical assets such as component libraries, parameterized templates, structured analysis workflows, or design tools.
• Strong technical communication skills with the ability to translate complex methods into clear, usable guidance for engineering teams.
• Self-directed work style suited to a globally distributed team spanning multiple countries and time zones.
• Willingness to travel approximately 10%, primarily to ADI sites in Europe and the US.
Preferred Qualifications:
• Experience with safety analysis methods specifically (FMEA, FMEDA, FTA) including failure mode identification and classification.
• Experience with Synopsys-Ansys Medini Analyze or comparable safety analysis tools (Isograph, ReliaSoft, APIS IQ, Safety Office).
• Familiarity with functional safety standards (ISO 26262, IEC 61508) at a conceptual level. Direct certification is not required.
• Experience developing training content, structured knowledge management systems, or technical curricula.
• Familiarity with automotive quality standards such as IATF 16949 or development process standards such as ASPICE.
Functional safety is one of the fastest-growing disciplines in semiconductor engineering, and this role gives you a structured way in — with mentoring, real project exposure, and the chance to build infrastructure that engineering teams across ADI rely on. If you've been looking for a role with more cross-portfolio visibility and a longer lever than single-program work, we'd like to hear from you.
For positions requiring access to technical data, Analog Devices, Inc. may have to obtain export  licensing approval from the U.S. Department of Commerce - Bureau of Industry and Security and/or the U.S. Department of State - Directorate of Defense Trade Controls.  As such, applicants for this position – except US Citizens, US Permanent Residents, and protected individuals as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3) – may have to go through an export licensing review process.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. The Position
The Opportunity
Roche, one of the leading global pharmaceutical companies, is delighted to announce the opening of its 2027 internship scheme for UK PhD students to join the Biostatistics team within the Product Development Data Sciences and Analytics (PDD) department located in Welwyn Garden City, UK.
Our biostatistics interns will work full-time for 10 weeks (extendable to 12 weeks) at our Roche Welwyn site under the supervision of experienced statisticians and data scientists. Interns will work on theoretical or applied problems with direct relevance to Roche’s ongoing clinical drug development in therapeutic areas such as oncology, immunology, infectious diseases, ophthalmology, or neuroscience.
There will be opportunities to interact with Roche’s global network of over 600 statisticians and data scientists. In addition to engaging in an exciting research topic, interns will have the opportunity to experience first-hand the work of statisticians and data scientists within the pharmaceutical industry and see how they add value to clinical development plans. Interns will learn both new technical and non-technical skills highly relevant to their future careers. At the end of the internship, students will give a department-wide presentation on their research topic.
Who you are
Applicants must currently be registered on a UK PhD programme with a significant methodological focus on statistics or data science, alongside relevant research experience within areas such as biostatistics/epidemiologists, statistics or mathematics, ideally but not necessarily with experience in the health sector. Applicants are required to have successfully passed their initial annual PhD review (typically held at 10-15 months) and must not have completed their PhD viva voce before the application closing date.
Application Process
Applications close on Friday, 13 November 2026. The application process may be extended beyond this date but could close at any point after this time.
Phase I: CV and Cover Letter Review (Your cover letter should not exceed two pages.)
As part of your cover letter, Roche is keen to understand your motivation in applying for this position. Also please include the following information:
• An introduction about yourself, confirming your availability for the face-to-face interview.
• Information about your PhD programme, current PhD status and year, confirmation that you have passed the initial annual review, and the expected viva voce date/year.
• A list of methodological or applied projects you have worked on in your PhD thesis, master’s dissertation, substantial undergraduate projects or previous internships and extracurricular activities, highlighting those within the relevant areas listed in the Requirements section.
• An explanation of why you are interested in the Roche internship programme, highlighting any relevant experience with health & medicine, biology, clinical trials or other non-statistical topics relevant to Roche.
• A description of broad areas (and specific topics, if you have any) in which you would be interested in working during the internship.
• A description of any skills or experience you have relevant to the role, such as team-working, multidisciplinary communication skills, etc.
• An explanation of whether you are eligible to work in the UK, have any visa restrictions or considerations regarding the paid/unpaid pathway, etc.
As an appendix to your cover letter, you can optionally attach a deliverable about one methodological or applied research project you have worked on and (nearly) completed, such as a published paper, working paper, master’s dissertation, or project report.
Phase II: In-person interview: Applicants should be available for a face-to-face interview in Welwyn Garden City on Friday 5th February 2027.
Please note:  Unfortunately visa sponsorship is not available for this role. Candidates must already hold valid authorisation to work in the UK.
Remuneration
Roche offers a competitive salary to a limited number of interns, who would normally be expected to pause their PhD stipend. For applicants from PhD programmes in which internships are an integral part of their PhD training (e.g., via the "Leave to Work Away" route while remaining registered in their PhD programme and continuing to receive the PhD stipend) or for those with visa-related restrictions, Roche can offer an unpaid internship, with alternative support to be agreed on a case-by-case basis. Authorisation from the university will normally be required to confirm the arrangement of the internship.
Working Environment and Culture
Roche offers the excellent benefits you would expect from a blue-chip organisation. There is a fully equipped gym on-site, a library and information centre, and an active sports and social club. We also have a subsidised staff restaurant providing food to cater to every taste throughout the day. At the heart of the building is an informal meeting area known as ‘The Street,’ which features a coffee shop, snack machines and cashpoint. A second building on-site, called ‘The Hub,’ contains modern meeting rooms and conference facilities.
Roche promotes personal well-being and work-life balance; therefore, flexible working options will be considered for all roles at Roche UK. Roche is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment. We foster diversity, equity and inclusion to reflect the communities we serve. When addressing healthcare on a global scale, diversity is essential to success. We believe that inclusion is key to understanding people’s varied healthcare needs. Together, we embrace individuality and share a passion for exceptional care. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.
Let’s build a healthier future, together.

You're the brains behind our work.
You’re ready to bring your knowledge from the classroom to the boardroom, and Citi wants to help you get there. Whether it’s honing your skills or building your network, we know that success can’t come without growth. Our programs equip you with the knowledge and training you need to play a valuable role on your team and establish a long-term career here. At Citi, we value internal mobility, and career growth is not a question of if, but when.
Citi is looking for a placement analyst to join the Equity Capital Markets (ECM) team in London, from January 2027. The ECM business works with our corporate, private equity and government clients,  providing advisory services on a wide range of activities including Initial Public Offerings (IPOs), Accelerated Equity Offerings (AEOs), Rights Issues, and other types of capital-raising projects). Our bankers work closely with our other business units to ensure client access to the full range of products and expertise within the organisation.
We provide you with the knowledge and skills you need to succeed.
We’re committed to teaching you the ropes. The Equity Capital Markets placement analyst program trains and grows key players in today’s changing economic environment and will equip them with the knowledge and training they need to help companies and governments raise capital in new and innovative ways. The 6-month program starts in January 2027. Successful Placement Analysts will be considered for a full-time position after graduation.
Your time here will look something like this...
•
Developing pitchbooks and executing ECM mandates for Citi clients (while working closely with M&A, Financing and Debt Capital Markets teams where necessary), interacting with clients and various levels of management
•
Managing the transaction process (compliance checks, committee approvals, liaising with research compliance), working with senior bankers and management on transaction terms
•
Analysing financial data and understanding financial models including stand-alone company valuations, discounted cash flow analysis, financing, comparative and pro-formal analyses
•
Developing a regular dialogue with Citi’s sales force globally and understanding the investor base. Interacting with Citi’s network around the globe to ensure activities are coordinated across the franchise
We want to hear from you if...
•
You are in your penultimate year of university
•
Expected to achieve or have achieved a 2:1 (or equivalent) at undergraduate level in any degree discipline.
•
You are available to start in January 2027.
Who we think will be a great fit...
If you enjoy deconstructing and analysing new situations, value and hard work creativity, and are motivated by creating a lasting impact with clients, the Citi Equity Capital Markets analyst program is a great step in your career. A dedication to learning and a true passion for the business are vital. As industries all over the globe continue to restructure and grow, we are hiring professionals who have a global perspective on the future of banking and want to make an impact on the corporate level. We value diversity of people and experiences and know you do as well.
We’ll also be looking for:
•
Desire to develop a deep understanding of the financial industry.
•
Intellectual curiosity, interest in the business, and proactive approach to searching for new and creative ideas
•
Strong communication, planning, and organizational skills.
•
Strong analytical skills, assimilating new information quickly and relating it to the needs of the client base
•
Ability to work efficiently within a team environment and as an individual contributor, managing own workload within tight deadlines
•
Commitment to personal growth and career development including mobility and flexibility. You also have a strong desire to learn, are proactive, building rapport and relationships in team environments.
•
Unquestioned commitment to integrity and ethical decision-making
We will recruit on a rolling basis and therefore encourage you to apply as soon as possible.
Successful candidates will be offered a competitive salary.
The role will be based at 25 - 33 Canada Square Canary Wharf - London, E14 5LB, United Kingdom.
This role currently offers a hybrid working model, with a mandatory three days in your assigned office, and an optional two days from home. Citi supports this business model, subject to business approval. Citi is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer.

Job summary
The purpose of the role is to provide IT support to Staff, Students and Lecturers at Istituto Marangoni London.
Key purpose of the role:
• IT Service – support staff, lecturers and students with IT issues and equipment reported through the IT Helpdesk or in person.
• The Helpdesk Specialist is responsible for maintaining the School's IT equipment, deploying new devices, managing repairs and providing support across both Apple macOS and Windows environments.
• Support the administration of Microsoft 365 services, Microsoft Entra ID and Mobile Device Management (MDM) solutions.
• Assist with maintaining the School's IT infrastructure, classroom technology and audio-visual equipment.
• Remote support to other campuses may occasionally be required.
• Provide technical support for School events both on-site and remotely.
• Contribute to improving IT processes through documentation, automation and continuous service improvement.
Key Responsibilities:
• Installation, configuration and support of computer hardware, operating systems and applications (Apple macOS and Windows).
• Build, configure and deploy laptops and desktops for new starters, contractors and replacement devices.
• Support the deployment and management of devices using Microsoft Intune, Apple Business Manager and Mobile Device Management (MDM) solutions.
• Support Microsoft 365 services including Microsoft Entra ID, Exchange Online, Microsoft Teams, SharePoint Online and OneDrive.
• Create, modify and maintain user accounts, access permissions and licences.
• Troubleshoot hardware, software and peripheral faults while liaising with third-party suppliers where required.
• Support wired and wireless networking, printers, classroom technology and meeting room equipment.
• Assist with audio-visual support for School events, presentations and graduation ceremonies.
• Install, test and evaluate software before deployment to users.
• Assist with maintaining IT asset records, stock levels and equipment lifecycle management.
• Create and maintain technical documentation, user guides and knowledge base articles.
• Assist with simple automation and scripting using Python, PowerShell or Microsoft Power Platform where appropriate.
• Train and guide users, both face-to-face and remotely, ensuring a professional, friendly and supportive approach.
• Employ IT best practice and follow School IT policies and security procedures.
• Assist with operating system updates, software deployment and endpoint security.
• Provide support, procedural documentation and relevant reports.
• Prioritise and manage multiple open support requests.
• Establish and maintain positive working relationships with staff, students and third-party suppliers.
• Undertake any other reasonable duties appropriate to the role.
Education and desirable skills
Essential
• Experience supporting Windows and Apple macOS devices.
• Good knowledge of Microsoft 365 applications.
• Basic understanding of Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD).
• Familiarity with Mobile Device Management (MDM) or Microsoft Intune.
• Excellent troubleshooting and customer service skills.
• Good written and verbal communication.
• Ability to prioritise workload and work independently.
• Basic networking knowledge (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, Wi-Fi).
Desirable
• Experience with Apple Business Manager.
• Basic knowledge of Python or PowerShell scripting.
• Experience with Microsoft Power Automate.
• Knowledge of SharePoint Online.
• Experience supporting Microsoft Teams.
• Experience with Cisco Meraki networking.
• ITIL Foundation or equivalent certification.
Salary: Up to £32,000

Head of Data & AI
Mattioli Woods Group  |  Full time  |  Hybrid
Mattioli Woods is looking for an exceptional data leader to define and deliver the Group's Data & AI agenda at a pivotal moment in our growth. This is a senior, strategic appointment — a genuine opportunity to shape how a £multi-billion wealth management group harnesses data, automation and artificial intelligence to serve clients and advisers more effectively.
You will join an organisation that is serious about transformation, with the sponsorship of the CIO and Executive Committee and the scope to build something that matters. If you are ready to move beyond the theoretical and drive measurable outcomes in a regulated, client-first environment, we would welcome a conversation.
What you'll be doing
• Define and deliver the Group Data & AI strategy and roadmap, moving rapidly from use cases and prototypes into measurable production outcomes
• Establish the foundations for data architecture, ownership, governance, quality and controls across a business that continues to grow through acquisition
• Map critical operational and adviser workflows, identifying and delivering opportunities for automation and AI-enabled productivity improvement
• Establish appropriate governance and controls for the responsible use of AI in an FCA-regulated environment, working alongside Enterprise Architecture and Information Security
• Build analytics and insight capabilities that enable better decisions for the business, advisers and clients
• Lead, build and develop a high-quality Data & AI team, supplementing internal capability with specialist partners where appropriate, and communicate investment cases and outcomes clearly to ExCo
What we're looking for
• A proven track record of building data and AI capabilities and translating them into measurable change in how a business operates
• Strong understanding of modern data platforms, governance, analytics and AI — grounded in business outcomes rather than technology for its own sake
• The ability to engage operational teams to understand complex workflows, collaborate with technical specialists on solutions, and present clearly to senior stakeholders
• Experience delivering data and AI transformation within financial services or another regulated environment; wealth management experience is useful but not essential
• Credibility establishing data architecture, governance frameworks, and quality controls at Group level
• A genuine delivery mindset — comfortable moving at pace from prototypes into production, and enthused by building capability rather than managing a large established function
Why join us
This is a rare opportunity to take genuine ownership of a Group-level data and AI agenda — not inheriting a mature function, but building one that will shape how Mattioli Woods operates for years to come. You will have direct access to the CIO and ExCo, meaningful resources, and the autonomy to make consequential decisions.
Mattioli Woods has grown significantly through acquisition and continues to do so. That creates a genuinely interesting data challenge: bringing coherence, insight and intelligence to a complex, expanding group while maintaining the client-first ethos at the heart of what we do. You will not be constrained to a narrow remit — this role evolves as the business does, and there is real scope to grow your own impact and the capability around you.

🤝  a senior technology leadership environment with direct access to the CIO and ExCo

As a Navigation Electronic Warfare Engineer, you will support vital work ensuring that MBDA missiles are able to navigate effectively in the most challenging electronic warfare environments.

Dynamic working: 5 days per week on-site due to workload classification and need for access to site test facilities
Security clearance: British Citizen or a Dual UK national with British citizenship.
Restrictions and/or limitations relating to nationality and/or rights to work may apply. As a minimum and after offer stage, all successful candidates will need to undergo HMG Basic Personnel Security Standard checks (BPSS), which are managed by the MBDA Personnel Security Team.

• Perform well on your placement and you could secure a graduate role before your final year

• Overtime: Opportunity for paid overtime

MBDA Missiles cannot complete their missions without critical Navigation Sensors on board, withstanding enemy interference and providing robust navigation data to guide the missile to the target. Your work will directly influence the design of real missiles, with frequent exposure to high-profile, fast-paced projects.
The Navigation Sensors Group are responsible for the design of the missile navigation subsystems, including identifying and testing equipment from specialist manufacturers – this includes GPS receivers, anti-jam equipment, and Inertial Measurement Units.
You can choose to be based at either our Stevenage or Bristol site. Over the course of your 10-week placement you’ll get involved in:
• Supporting tests and trials to evaluate and assess navigation equipment performance
• Hands-on research and design activities to develop the next generation of navigation equipment
• Monitoring supplier and technology developments and identifying future technologies
• Collaborating with suppliers and researchers for the development and maturation of new and emerging technology

In this role, you’ll work in a varied and dynamic environment, including as part of an international team with our colleagues in MBDA France and the wider MBDA Group. You’ll work alongside other departments to increase your knowledge on the complexities of a missile, including datalinks, seekers and sensors, and work closely with Integration and System Validation teams.
The work is technically challenging, innovative and rewarding. You’ll be working alongside experienced engineers who will encourage and help you develop the skills required to be an effective Navigation Electronic Warfare

Current undergraduate working towards a degree in a Physics, Mathematics, Electronics, or Engineering discipline.

Better Together: Work closely with engineering, data science, commercial and product partners, building deep trust through transparent communication and shared outcomes.

We are seeking an exceptional technology leader to join the Global Portfolio Solutions (GPS) team. This role will be the connective tissue between Carlyle’s investment professionals and the technology leadership at our portfolio companies – translating strategic investment theses into concrete technology execution roadmaps, and converting lessons learned across the portfolio into scalable playbooks, partnerships, and community.
Above all, this person will serve as a trusted thought partner to deal teams and portfolio company technology leaders alike – leveraging deep technical and operational expertise, strong listening skills, and a practitioner’s credibility to drive outsized technology value creation across the portfolio. • Define and drive software development / engineering value-creation agendas across technology portfolio companies — product architecture, scalability, technical debt, cloud modernization, AI in SDLC and AI in Product .

• undefined

• undefined

• undefined

• Demonstrable growth in new customers and first trades from Europe and the Middle East
• Performance at or below our CAC and payback targets
• Compliant, high-quality partner activity with robust monitoring in place
• A clear playbook and a business case showing the value of making the role permanent

• Proven experience in affiliate or partnership marketing, with a track record of recruiting partners and growing the channel
• Strong commercial and negotiation skills, comfortable agreeing performance-based deals such as CPA and revenue share
• Experience managing partners through affiliate networks and tracking platforms
• A data-led approach, with the ability to analyse performance and optimise against acquisition cost
• Experience working across international markets, ideally in Europe and the Middle East, with an understanding of local market differences
• Strong stakeholder management and the ability to work independently and at pace
• Strong eye for detail, especially around compliance and partner quality
• Curiosity about AI and how it can improve how we work
Ideally you will also have
• An existing network of affiliates in finance, trading or investing
• Experience in financial services, fintech or another regulated industry
• Language skills such as German, French or Arabic, which are an advantage
• Experience with affiliate platforms such as Impact, Awin or
•

We are looking for an experienced IT Project Manager to lead the end-to-end ISIT project coordination for the start-up and roll-out of a new sauce and liquid production facility in the UK.
The role will be responsible for ensuring that all required IT and IS components are effectively coordinated, delivered, tested, secured and ready before factory go-live. This includes close coordination with the ERP workstream, as well as responsibility for business applications, infrastructure, cybersecurity, shopfloor connectivity, manufacturing IT, testing, training, cutover and hypercare.
The IT Project Manager will act as the key coordination point between local site leadership, Group ISIT, the ERP Lead and ERP programme teams, infrastructure and operations teams, cybersecurity, application owners, engineering teams, external partners, and machine and equipment suppliers.

The UK IT Project Manager will ensure the effective coordination and delivery of the overall ISIT scope required for the successful start-up of the new facility.

UK Factory Project, 80%

• Define and coordinate IT infrastructure requirements for the site, including network, Wi-Fi, cabling, firewalls, connectivity, PCs, printers, scanners, handheld devices, shopfloor terminals, label printers and other operational equipment.
• Coordinate manufacturing IT requirements related to production lines, machine connectivity, SCADA and OT environments, PLCs, production data capture, traceability, weighing, labelling, scanning and line-side terminals.
• Ensure cybersecurity requirements are embedded into infrastructure, applications and OT designs, in coordination with the relevant cybersecurity and technical owners.
• Build and coordinate the integrated ISIT testing, UAT, training, cutover, go-live readiness and hypercare plans, ensuring alignment with the ERP workstream.
• Ensure project issues are tracked, prioritised, escalated and resolved effectively before and after go-live.

We work as part of the firm's wider modelling community, sharing knowledge and best practice with other modelling experts.
The Associate Directors in the team are responsible for leading the delivery of modelling assignments, and for executing work of the most complex nature. • Provide coaching and training to junior team members
• Contribute to the operational and interpersonal success of the team
Knowing you’re right for us

• Currently holding a senior manager or equivalent grade

• Strong understanding of modelling best practice ideas

• Logical approach to problem-solving, attention to detail
